title: The court audit counted 29 accounts of unknown age as over 360 days old

beats.text: In 2006, San Francisco and its court agreed to collect overdue debt together.

visual.sub: The City and Court shared a collections program

beats.text: The audit said 1,080 accounts were over 360 days old.

visual.kicker: The report counted 29 accounts of unknown age as over 360 days

beats.text: Its table gives 29 of those accounts an unknown age.
That unknown group owed more than $12,000.

visual.kicker: The report counted 29 accounts of unknown age as over 360 days

beats.text: The balance rows also fall $270 short of the printed total.
The amount collected does add up.

visual.kicker: The six balance rows fall $270 short of the printed total

beats.text: The wider program reported a 14% recovery rate that year.

visual.kicker: The broader program collected $4.64 million that fiscal year

beats.text: By March 2010, the Court had begun sending cases to outside agencies.

visual.kicker: The broader program collected $4.64 million that fiscal year

beats.text: In 2022, California canceled unpaid balances for certain civil assessments.

visual.kicker: A 2022 law changed which civil assessments the Court could collect

beats.text: The table does not say which accounts contained those fees.
